accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text). Use text-slate-700 for light mode body, text-slate-300 for dark mode.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.

images.description: Professional male avatar for user profile in settings/header

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Include Sun for logo, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Zap, Battery, History, Settings, Download.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Font 'Plus Jakarta Sans' via index.css import or next/font.
The UI MUST match the reference layout: Sidebar on left (dark navy #0f1e3d gradient with Sun icon logo). Main area on right.
Dashboard layout: Top row is 6 KPI cards (Current Credit, Today's Export, Today's Import, Net Today, Monthly Export, Estimated Savings).
Below KPIs: Split layout. Left is 'Add New Reading' dual-column form card. Right is 'Credit Trend' Chart.js graph and 'Today's Summary'.
Cards MUST be rounded-2xl, white (or slate-900 in dark mode), with soft shadows, NOT harsh borders.
KPI icons must be circular and colored: Green for export, Red for import, Blue for Net, Yellow/Orange for Credit.
Add 'Units' text softly next to large KPI numbers.
Use Chart.js (react-chartjs-2) for analytics (Bars for Export/Import, Line for Net Credit).
Include loading skeleton states for dashboard cards before data mounts.
Do not use generic Inter font. Apply Plus Jakarta Sans universally.

For all Shadcn components (tables, dialogs, forms), ensure they use standard React/Tailwind .js or .jsx (not tsx). Override default Shadcn styles to match the rounded, soft-shadow modern glass UI vibe.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft box-shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (like the header).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Add transitions explicitly.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, active scaling).
Use generous padding (p-5, p-6) in cards so they don't look cramped.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
